manual_cli_acceptance.source:
import sys,json,tempfile,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts'))
from query_acceptance import seed_history
binary=str(Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve())
def run(*args):
 p=subprocess.run([binary,*args],capture_output=True,text=True)
 assert p.returncode==0,(args,p.stdout,p.stderr)
 return json.loads(p.stdout)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='dctx0-workflow-cli-') as directory:
 root=Path(directory)
 (root/'spec.dctx0').write_text('workspace W { type A = Int }')
 run('check',str(root),'--json')
 identifier,_=seed_history(root,12)
 run('query','prepare',str(root),'--json')
 page=run('verify','show',str(root),identifier,'--cause','unclassified','--limit','2','--json')
 assert page['matching_cases']==8,page
 assert len(page['cases'])==2
 assert all(c['diagnosis']['cause']=='unclassified' for c in page['cases'])
 report=run('verify','compare',str(root),identifier,identifier,'--limit','2','--json')
 assert report['resolved']==0 and report['changed']==8,report
 assert len(report['issues'])==2 and report['next_offset']==2,report
 second=run('verify','compare',str(root),identifier,identifier,'--offset','2','--limit','2','--json')
 assert second['issues'][0]['case_id']!=report['issues'][0]['case_id']
 print(json.dumps({'status':'pass','assertions':7,'scope':'synthetic imported CLI diagnostics/comparison; no native execution claim','binary':binary}))

manual_native_comparison.source:
import json,sys,tempfile,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
binary=str(Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve())
def command(*args,success=True):
 p=subprocess.run([binary,*args,'--json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
 if success:assert p.returncode==0,(args,p.stdout[:2000],p.stderr)
 return json.loads(p.stdout)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='dctx0-native-compare-') as directory:
 root=Path(directory);spec=root/'spec';app=root/'app';spec.mkdir();app.mkdir()
 (spec/'w.dctx0').write_text('workspace W { surface Api {\n'+''.join(f'operation {name}(value: Int) -> Int {{\npure\nensures result == value\n}}\n' for name in ['a','b','z'])+'} }')
 command('check',str(spec))
 command('verify','init',str(spec),'--project',str(app),'--target','typescript','--subject','W.Api.a','--subject','W.Api.b','--subject','W.Api.z')
 config_path=app/'.dctx0/testing/verification.json';config=json.loads(config_path.read_text());config['budgets']['generated_cases']=1;config_path.write_text(json.dumps(config))
 (app/'package.json').write_text('{"type":"module"}')
 original='export function a(value:bigint){return value;}\nexport function b(value:bigint){return value;}\nexport function z(value:bigint){return value;}\n'
 (app/'app.ts').write_text(original)
 adapter_path=app/'.dctx0/testing/typescript/adapter.ts'
 adapter="""import {a,b,z} from '../../../app.ts';
import {AdapterError,invokeApplication} from './contract.ts';
const functions={'W.Api.a':a,'W.Api.b':b,'W.Api.z':z};
export const adapter={
 async describe(){return {protocol_version:1,subjects:Object.keys(functions).map(subject=>({subject,role:'operation',artifact:'app.ts',entry_point:subject.slice(-1)})),artifacts:['app.ts'],capabilities:['sessions','invocation','events','call-observation','resource-observation'],representations:{Int:'exact bigint'}};},
 async begin(){return {async invoke(i){if(i.subject==='W.Api.z')throw new AdapterError('missing z binding');return invokeApplication(()=>functions[i.subject](BigInt(i.arguments[0].value)),value=>({kind:'integer',value:String(value)}));},async close(){}};}
};"""
 adapter_path.write_text(adapter)
 before=command('verify','run',str(spec),'--project',str(app),'--no-adopt','--full',success=False)['evidence']
 adapter_path.write_text(adapter.replace("if(i.subject==='W.Api.z')throw new AdapterError('missing z binding');",''))
 repaired=command('verify','run',str(spec),'--project',str(app),'--no-adopt','--full')['evidence']
 repair=command('verify','compare',str(spec),before['id'],repaired['id'],'--limit','1')
 assert repair['resolved']==1 and repair['new']==0,repair
 adapter_cases=command('verify','show',str(spec),before['id'],'--cause','adapter','--limit','10')
 assert adapter_cases['matching_cases']==1,adapter_cases
 (app/'app.ts').write_text(original.replace('a(value:bigint){return value;}','a(value:bigint){return value+1n;}').replace('b(value:bigint){return value;}','b(value:bigint){return value-1n;}'))
 after=command('verify','run',str(spec),'--project',str(app),'--no-adopt','--full',success=False)['evidence']
 regression=command('verify','compare',str(spec),repaired['id'],after['id'],'--limit','1')
 assert regression['new']==2 and regression['resolved']==0,regression
 assert regression['total_issues']==2 and regression['next_offset']==1,regression
 violations=command('verify','show',str(spec),after['id'],'--cause','contract-violation','--limit','10')
 assert violations['matching_cases']==2,violations
 unavailable=command('verify','compare',str(spec),before['id'],after['id'],'--limit','1')
 assert unavailable['new']==2 and unavailable['resolved']==0 and unavailable['unproven']==1,unavailable
 assert len(before['run']['cases'])==len(repaired['run']['cases'])==len(after['run']['cases'])==3
 assert not repaired['run']['provenance']['incomplete'],repaired['run']['provenance']['incomplete']
 assert not after['run']['provenance']['incomplete'],after['run']['provenance']['incomplete']
 print(json.dumps({'status':'pass','scope':'actual Bun operations and central clause assessment; no task adoption; repair recorded before source-case pruning','assertions':9,'runs':[before['id'],repaired['id'],after['id']],'evidence':[before,repaired,after],'repair_before_pruning':repair,'new_contract_violations':regression,'comparison_after_pruning':unavailable}))
